title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Here in Saudi Arabia, Asr salah is offered according to the Hanbali maslak which is not the time of Asr according to Hanafi. In such case what should a Hanafi follower do? either leave the Jmaah and offer the salah later or join the jamah with them, because it is a daily problem for those who are living here in KSA. 6844 views Q. I am a resident of Ottawa, Canada. During Summer season in the month of May, June, July and August we have to pray Isha Salaat very late in the night. For example, Isha Salaat on June 1st starts at 10:39 and in the middle of the month it goes up to 10:54. This causes undue hardship to people. And we foresee, it will cause lots of hardship during Ramadan when people will pray 20 Rakah Tarawih. We know that in Hanafi Fiqh there is provision to start Isha Salaat at the Shafaq Ahmar time. We seek your Fatwa and opinion on praying Salaat earlier at locations that have Isha times very late in the night. 3343 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1058 Country: United States of America Title: My question is that the masjid thats near to me is barailwi maslaq and they are very strict about it. they are bidati. i have to go there for jumma prayer only bcoz that is the nearest one otherwise i have to go far for the other masjid. is it not permissible to pray behind bidati or barailwi imam? Question: Asalamualaikum! mufti sb my question is that the masjid thats near to me is barailwi maslaq and they are very strict about it. they are bidati. i have to go there for jumma prayer only bcoz that is the nearest one otherwise i have to go far for the other masjid. is it not permissible to pray behind bidati or barailwi imam? Jazak Allah khair Answer ID: 1058 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 323/307/D) According to a Hadith, there are six special amaal of Friday: (1) bathing (2) going early in the mosque (3) going on feet (4) sitting nearer to imam (5) not engaging in nonsense (6) lend one?s ear to khutbah . One who acts upon this Hadith, he has been promised reward of one year nafl salah and nafl fast on every step. Going far for praying Juma salah will bring more rewards. Therefore, it is better for you to go to farther mosque so that you can pray satisfactorily and get more rewards. As far as praying salah behind Bralewi imam is concerned if his beliefs are tantamount to shirk then the salah behind him will be invalid; otherwise it will be makrroh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
